reviews.review_description:
Framerate extremely low its not comfortable nor realistically playable, image quality is so low, the game is jittery, its un-optimised, there is zero optimization here it plays like they somehow got the pc version installed on the Q3 and obv the game is barely running, this would of never ever passed any half decent QA, theres no Quality Control here & im stunned that Meta even greenlit this title to be released on there platform,,, 

This is Unacceptable, the gameplay video used is not from the Quest version of the game, thats false advertising, the difference between gameplay shown and the actual quest gameplay is worlds apart, its the worse case of false advertising I've seen in a very very long time, im getting a refund, shame on the devs and shame on meta for allowing this,
